decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to build up a strong board presence quickly by playing mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, ramping into powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also aims to generate a large amount of green mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa to power out big spells like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator. The inclusion of cards like Lovestruck Beast and Wolfwillow Haven provide additional ways to apply pressure and establish a strong board presence.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds a late-game threat that can help secure victory. Additionally, the deck features a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and also includes removal spells like Dreadbore to deal with opposing threats.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on early aggressive creatures like Elvish Mystic and Lovestruck Beast, backed up by powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship. The deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent and finish them off with big attacks. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana ramping. The deck also includes removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to deal with threats. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around fast and efficient beatdowns to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck aims to assemble the Lotus Field combo as quickly as possible using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap the land. Once Lotus Field is on the battlefield, the deck can generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The deck also includes cards like Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages to dig for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck focuses on efficiently assembling its combo and overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with green devotion cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then play big threats like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Storm the Festival and Oath of Nissa help to find these key creatures efficiently. Teferi, Nicol Bolas, and various planeswalkers provide additional utility and threats. Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Forests enable big mana plays, allowing for powerful interactions and overwhelming pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to quickly build a huge board presence and dominate the game.

This deck focuses on quickly getting Arclight Phoenix into play by casting spells that draw cards, fill the graveyard, and deal damage to opponents' creatures. It also utilizes disruptive cards like Thing in the Ice and Spell Pierce to control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and utilize the powerful recursion ability of Arclight Phoenix to close out games swiftly. The deck's consistency is improved through card selection and draw spells, allowing for explosive turns and maintaining pressure on the opponent.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while putting pressure on them with efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also has a strong graveyard interaction with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser, allowing for additional value and resilience. Overall, the goal is to apply consistent pressure and control the game until securing a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with low-cost creatures and buffing them with various abilities to overwhelm the opponent. It aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while protecting its own creatures with cards like Brave the Elements. The deck's mana base allows for consistency in casting its creatures and spells, with some utility lands for additional benefits. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive, small creatures working together and supporting each other to quickly beat down the opponent.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to control the board by sacrificing creatures to search for higher-cost threats or disruptive permanents. With Yorion as a companion, the deck can also take advantage of its enter-the-battlefield effect to flicker key creatures and generate value. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures and enchantments to facilitate this strategy, along with lands that provide multiple colors of mana to support the deck's diverse mana requirements. Overall, the goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and strategic plays.

The deck revolves around assembling the Greasefang, Parhelion combo to generate a powerful board presence and win the game quickly. By using cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' strategies and cards like Grisly Salvage to find key pieces, the deck aims to set up a strong board state with Greasefang and Parhelion II. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Rotting Regisaur and Satyr Wayfinder to provide early game pressure and card advantage. With a mixture of creatures and spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through the combo.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, along with mana ramp from cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provides additional removal and reach, while cards like The Akroan War and Obliterating Bolt can help clear the way for your creatures to attack. The land base includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Lair of the Hydra to give the deck flexibility in different situations.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures like Llanowar Elves and Lovestruck Beast to apply pressure on the opponent. Key cards include Reckless Stormseeker to give haste, Bonecrusher Giant for removal, and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship for additional damage. Esika's Chariot can create multiple threats, while Obliterating Bolt can deal with problematic creatures. The deck also utilizes The Akroan War to gain control of opposing creatures. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck looks to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and powerful strategy.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize, while also dealing direct damage with cards like Bonecrusher Giant. The deck also utilizes graveyard interactions with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, to provide additional threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy, allowing for consistent access to the necessary colors of mana to cast spells efficiently.

This deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures for value and damage, utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil to create a dangerous synergy. Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute allow for stealing opponent's creatures and sacrificing them for additional benefits. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and a potential win condition. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature sacrifice, burn, and graveyard recursion, while maintaining a steady flow of damage and disruption.

The focus of this Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with low-cost, evasive spirit creatures while disrupting their strategy with counter spells and removal. By utilizing cards like Mausoleum Wanderer and Shacklegeist to control the board and Supreme Phantom to pump up your spirits, you can quickly chip away at your opponent's life total. Curious Obsession helps you draw cards while putting pressure on the opponent, and Faceless Haven provides a powerful late-game threat. Slip Out the Back and Geistlight Snare offer additional removal options to keep the opponent on their toes.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro-Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost and efficient creatures such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, and Luminarch Aspirant. By curving out with early plays like Kytheon, Hero of Akros and Hopeful Initiate and leveraging anthems like Thalia's Lieutenant, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of protection spells like Brave the Elements helps to protect the board from removal and push through the final points of damage. Additional lands like Castle Ardenvale and utility lands like Mutavault provide extra reach and versatility to the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing small, aggressive creatures with protection and evasion abilities to maintain tempo and overwhelm the opponent. It includes a mix of low-cost Spirits and Humans to benefit from synergy with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar. The mana base is designed to provide consistency and flexibility in play, with access to various colors for support cards like Brave the Elements and Reflector Mage. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly building a board presence and pressuring the opponent while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck focuses on aggressively building up green mana devotion to power out big threats like Lovestruck Beast and Old-Growth Troll. By ramping with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, you can play out your powerful threats quickly and overwhelm your opponent. With cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to help ramp up your mana, along with Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to untap your lands, you can quickly establish a dominant board presence and control the game.

This deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents. Using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to quickly assemble the key pieces needed for the combo while also disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Raffine's Informant and Satyr Wayfinder to help with card selection and graveyard filling. With a mix of control, card advantage, and powerful creatures, this deck is designed to be versatile and resilient in a variety of matchups.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards that deal damage quickly and efficiently. The key strategy involves overwhelming the opponent with small but powerful creatures and burn spells, aiming to reduce their life total to zero as quickly as possible. By utilizing a combination of hasty creatures and direct damage spells, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and force them to react defensively, ultimately leading to a swift victory through relentless aggression.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Lotus Field and other ramp spells to cast Emergent Ultimatum and potentially win the game on the spot by fetching powerful combo pieces or game-ending spells. The deck utilizes a variety of card selection spells and tutors to find the combo pieces it needs to execute its game plan efficiently. The inclusion of Omniscience allows for explosive plays and can help chain multiple spells together to overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on assembling its combo pieces and executing a game-winning sequence to dominate the opponent.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Lotus Field combo by ramping up with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. The deck includes various tutors and card draw spells to find the pieces needed for the combo, ultimately leading to a powerful Emergent Ultimatum or Omniscience play to dominate the game. The deck also runs utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City to protect its key pieces. Overall, the deck is focused on efficiently assembling the Lotus Field combo and overwhelming the opponent with powerful plays.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize various removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through efficient removal and hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also utilizing powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to dominate the battlefield. The deck also includes graveyard synergies with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Invoke Despair to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy and ensure consistent access to black mana sources.

This deck aims to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent by utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of removal spells and land destruction to keep the opponent on their toes. The deck is designed to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and synergies to control the board and deal incremental damage to the opponent. It aims to take advantage of cards like Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil to generate value from sacrificing creatures. Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push help control the opponent's creatures and clear the way for attacks. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan through sacrifice tactics.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with lifelink and flying abilities to quickly pressure opponents and gain life. The key strategy involves efficiently deploying threats such as Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel while disrupting opponents with Skyclave Apparition. Collected Company allows for explosive creature plays, while Bishop of Wings and Youthful Valkyrie support the aggressive game plan. Reidane, God of the Worthy and Tomik, Distinguished Advokist provide additional disruption against control and ramp decks. The mana base is optimized for consistent white mana sources to support the aggressive Selesnya strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of card draw, self-mill, and protection spells to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for the Thassa's Oracle win condition. By cycling through the deck with cards like Treasure Cruise and Demonic Bargain, while also filling up the graveyard with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Deadly Dispute, the player aims to win the game by either drawing their entire library with Jace, Wielder of Mysteries or having Thassa's Oracle enter the battlefield with no cards left in the library.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures. By playing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant, you can quickly build a wide board presence and pump up your creatures. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts your opponent's spells while Adeline, Resplendent Cathar provides additional value by creating tokens. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, using Brave the Elements to protect your creatures and push through damage. Shefet Dunes and Mutavault provide additional ways to pump up your team and close out games quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to flood the board with small, aggressive creatures known as "weenies" and buff them up with anthem effects like Thalia's Lieutenant. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy, backed up by protection spells like Brave the Elements. This deck aims to get ahead early and maintain pressure on the opponent with a relentless stream of efficient threats. The inclusion of cards like Kytheon, Hero of Akros and Luminarch Aspirant also provide additional support and versatility to the deck's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly populate the battlefield with small, aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Kytheon, Hero of Akros and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to boost the creatures' power, along with protection spells like Brave the Elements, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and apply pressure early in the game. The inclusion of lands like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale also enhance the deck's ability to consistently produce creatures and maintain pressure on the opponent.
